section.name: Maven Plugin
section.p:
The Tomcat Maven Plugin provides goals to manipulate WAR projects within the Apache Tomcat servlet container.
You can run your War Apache Maven project through Maven without deploying your war file to an Apache Tomcat instance.
More details are available in the Maven generated site :
Version 2.0-SNAPSHOT (under developpement)
Version 2.0-beta-1 (released version)

subsection.name: Sources
subsection.p: Sources are located in the following svn path : http://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/tomcat/maven-plugin/trunk/ .

subsection.p: The Bug Tracker to use is the ASF Jira instance : https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MTOMCAT
